name: Boadach
text: Boadach rules the Land of the Living. His name means victorious or triumphant in Irish. A fairy woman in the tale Echtrae Conli, the Adventure of Connla, tells of this land. The Land of the Living is a variation of Mag Mell, the Pleasant Plain. His rule places him in the otherworld of early Irish story.

attributes.attribute: the ruler of the Land of the Living
named in the tale Echtrae Conli
